svg.text: Breadboard bench check, 3V3 logic only, one part group per peripheral
CLOCK IN: loop-back only, no external signals
UNVERIFIED: IIC/SPI pads, if any, in SPI position
Phase 0 bench validation, 3V3 logic only. Run firmware/pico/test_hw.py per-peripheral.
test_hw.py's OLED test draws through display.OLED_SPI. GP11 (gate input) is unused here.
OLED chip (SH1106) and 7-pin order (GND VCC CLK MOSI RES DC CS) are owner-stated.
